comment: Ep94 France vs Paraguay (Play-Offs) — theme 'THE ROOSTER AND THE NIGHT SPIRIT'. France = Les Bleus (the Gallic Rooster / Vercingetorix); Paraguay = La Albirroja (the Pombéro night spirit). RESULT France 1-0 Paraguay, Mbappé from the penalty spot. France dominate, Paraguay defend heroically, Mbappé wins it late from the spot. Legend 094 = Vercingetorix, the Gaul King. Name-sync onsets match showcase clip starts.

lines.text: At dawn on the ramparts a golden rooster lifts its head and crows to the sky — the spirit of France, proud, defiant, unbroken since the days of the Gauls.
And deep in the moonlit forests of Paraguay a guardian stirs — the Pombéro, the night spirit of the Guaraní, protector of those the world counts out.
Welcome back to WorldCup twenty-six Legends — episode ninety-four. France, versus Paraguay. A play-off. Win, or the dream dies.
France arrive as world champions — a storm of blue talent, the deepest squad on earth. Paraguay arrive as La Albirroja, back on the big stage and fearless.
France — Les Bleus. Champions, and blessed with more firepower than anyone.
Kylian Mbappé, the captain, is pure lightning — the fastest man in the game. Antoine Griezmann is the brain who pulls every string. And Ousmane Dembélé is the tormentor no full-back can hold.
Aurélien Tchouaméni is the colossus who shields it all. And William Saliba is ice at the back, calm as a winter morning.
Paraguay — La Albirroja. Organised, ferocious, and unafraid of anyone.
Gustavo Gómez, the captain, is the wall they build everything on. Miguel Almirón is the spark who runs all night. And Julio Enciso is the flame who can light it up from nothing.
Diego Gómez drives the engine in midfield. And Antonio Sanabria is the spearhead who leads the line alone.
So here is the riddle. Can the Albirroja hold the line for ninety minutes? Or does the lightning finally break through?
And stay with me — because this one is settled, late, from twelve yards.
Here is how we see it. France pour forward in waves of blue, and Paraguay are pinned inside their own half.
Gustavo Gómez throws his body in the way again and again. Paraguay stand firm, heroic, refusing to break.
And they nearly steal it — Enciso flashes a shot inches wide, and all of Paraguay holds its head.
But Les Bleus keep coming, and the pressure tells. A tangle in the box — and the referee points to the spot.
Kylian Mbappé steps up. Ice cold. And he buries it. One — nil, France.
One goal. That is all it takes. France hold on, and the rooster crows into the night.
One — nil. Paraguay defended like lions, and gave everything — but Mbappé was ice from the spot, and France found the one moment they needed.
The result — France one, Paraguay nil. Mbappé, the penalty. The champions march on.
And Paraguay go home with their heads high — La Albirroja who made the world champions sweat for every single inch.
France march on. Les Bleus, ruthless when it matters, still chasing the crown.
So you tell me — the rooster, or the night spirit? Comment FRANCE for Les Bleus — comment PARAGUAY for La Albirroja.
Two thousand years ago one man united the tribes of Gaul and defied an empire — Vercingetorix, the great chieftain, the soul of France that never surrenders.
The players write the night. But Vercingetorix carries one truth — a people who stand together, and never bow, can never truly be conquered.
